A1.observation: Packaging/testing is one bounded source-based industrial pilot, not the default target-account universe. No front-end fab imagery; wider supply-chain ICP is not replaced.

A2.observation: Only local entities with real management need and decision scope fit; large centrally managed groups are not assumed addressable. This content pilot makes no eligibility assertion.

A3.observation: FDI zh-Hans operations reader with finance collaborator. Chinese authored all fields; old finance-first draft not adopted. Ownership and local ERP authority not inferred from language.

A4.observation: Implicit value: fewer waits/repeated reconciliation and clearer lot/cut-off/handoff responsibility. Named China result15to5 is time outcome, not financial ROI or promise.

A5.observation: Domestic VN readiness bridge is not applicable to this FDI Simplified Chinese operations journey.

A6.observation: Lot cut-off, unfinished work, completion/loss source records and handoff ownership give relevant depth; no required recipe/audit topic stuffing.

A7.observation: Question -> records -> responsibility -> shared review -> China proof -> named case reading. Taiwan context and China outcome are separated; proof is not ERP-only causality.
